03
Personal · Shipped
SHEETLINE
🔒 Files never leave your device

I made this for auditing companies who work between PDFs and spreadsheets every day. PDF → Excel batch-extracts selectable text into a traceable workbook where every line keeps its source file, page and position — and scanned pages are flagged instead of silently coming out blank. Excel → PDF does the reverse, turning a workbook into a clean, readable PDF with headings repeated on every page. Everything runs in the browser, so client files stay private.

📄 PDF → Excel
📊 Excel → PDF
🔗 Page-linked records
🗂️ Multiple PDFs per batch
🚩 Scanned pages flagged
🔁 Headings repeat on every page
🔒 100% local processing
